title: The Strongest Build
statementMd:
Ivan is playing yet another roguelike computer game. He controls a single hero in the game. The hero has $n$ equipment slots. There is a list of $c_i$ items for the $i$-th slot, the $j$-th of them increases the hero strength by $a_{i,j}$. The items for each slot are pairwise distinct and are listed in the increasing order of their strength increase. So, $a_{i,1} \lt a_{i,2} \lt \dots \lt a_{i,c_i}$.

For each slot Ivan chooses exactly one item. Let the chosen item for the $i$-th slot be the $b_i$-th item in the corresponding list. The sequence of choices $[b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n]$ is called *a build*.

The strength of a build is the sum of the strength increases of the items in it. Some builds are banned from the game. There is a list of $m$ pairwise distinct banned builds. It's guaranteed that there's at least one build that's not banned.

What is the build with the maximum strength that is not banned from the game? If there are multiple builds with maximum strength, print any of them.

## Input

The first line contains a single integer $n$ ($1 \le n \le 10$) — the number of equipment slots.

The $i$-th of the next $n$ lines contains the description of the items for the $i$-th slot. First, one integer $c_i$ ($1 \le c_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$) — the number of items for the $i$-th slot. Then $c_i$ integers $a_{i,1}, a_{i,2}, \dots, a_{i,c_i}$ ($1 \le a_{i,1} \lt a_{i,2} \lt \dots \lt a_{i,c_i} \le 10^8$).

The sum of $c_i$ doesn't exceed $2 \cdot 10^5$.

The next line contains a single integer $m$ ($0 \le m \le 10^5$) — the number of banned builds.

Each of the next $m$ lines contains a description of a banned build — a sequence of $n$ integers $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ ($1 \le b_i \le c_i$).

The builds are pairwise distinct, and there's at least one build that's not banned.

## Output

Print the build with the maximum strength that is not banned from the game. If there are multiple builds with maximum strength, print any of them.
statementZhMd:
伊万又在玩一款 roguelike 电脑游戏。他在游戏中控制一名英雄。英雄有 $n$ 个装备栏。对于第 $i$ 个装备栏，有一个包含 $c_i$ 件物品的列表，其中第 $j$ 件物品会使英雄的强度增加 $a_{i,j}$。每个装备栏中的物品两两不同，并且按照强度增量递增的顺序排列。因此，$a_{i,1} \lt a_{i,2} \lt \dots \lt a_{i,c_i}$。

伊万为每个装备栏恰好选择一件物品。设第 $i$ 个装备栏选择的是对应列表中的第 $b_i$ 件物品。选择序列 $[b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n]$ 称为一种 *构筑*。

一种构筑的强度等于其中所有物品的强度增量之和。游戏中有一些构筑被禁止使用，并给出了包含 $m$ 种两两不同的被禁止构筑的列表。保证至少存在一种未被禁止的构筑。

未被禁止的构筑中，强度最大的构筑是什么？如果有多个强度最大的构筑，输出其中任意一种。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 10$）——装备栏的数量。

接下来的 $n$ 行中，第 $i$ 行描述第 $i$ 个装备栏中的物品。首先输入一个整数 $c_i$（$1 \le c_i \le 2 \cdot 10^5$）——第 $i$ 个装备栏中的物品数量。然后输入 $c_i$ 个整数 $a_{i,1}, a_{i,2}, \dots, a_{i,c_i}$（$1 \le a_{i,1} \lt a_{i,2} \lt \dots \lt a_{i,c_i} \le 10^8$）。

保证 $c_i$ 的总和不超过 $2 \cdot 10^5$。

下一行包含一个整数 $m$（$0 \le m \le 10^5$）——被禁止的构筑数量。

接下来的 $m$ 行中，每行描述一种被禁止的构筑，即一个包含 $n$ 个整数 $b_1, b_2, \dots, b_n$ 的序列（$1 \le b_i \le c_i$）。

这些构筑两两不同，并且至少存在一种未被禁止的构筑。

## 输出格式

输出未被禁止的构筑中强度最大的构筑。如果有多个强度最大的构筑，输出其中任意一种。
